text:
samir: Heads-up onboarding pelican-80k-int3. Short smoke shows clean behavior until ~49k then abrupt token corruption and kv fingerprint swap. Dump + mini repro below.

samir: quick repro (fast):
```bash
./quick_run.sh --model pelican-80k-int3 --quant int3 --context 81920 --prompt fixtures/repeat_until_50k.txt --seed 11 --out /tmp/pelican.out
```

samir: trimmed log snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T10:11:03Z] t=48988 emit="and" p=0.18 kv_idx=48988 fp=0x4f1a phase=0x7ffc
[2026-04-02T10:11:04Z] t=49999 emit="the" p=0.22 kv_idx=49999 fp=0x4fff phase=0x7fff
[2026-04-02T10:11:04Z] t=50000 emit="<STRANGE>" p=0.92 kv_idx=50000 fp=0x8009 phase=0x8009  # sudden phase+fingerprint jump
```

dina: does pelican-80k-fp16 (baseline) show same breakpoint? and is this deterministic across restarts?

samir: fp16 baseline goes to full context fine. Repro is deterministic on same seed.

oliver: can you dump kv keys around 49992..50005 with phases & short hex keys? `tools/kvpeek --range 49992-50005 --hex`

samir: kvpeek output: 
```
49992 key=0xdec1 phase=0x7ff8
49997 key=0xdee6 phase=0x7ffd
49999 key=0x4fff phase=0x7fff
50000 key=0x8009 phase=0x8009  # wrap occurs here at 50000
50001 key=0x800a phase=0x800a
```

mira: 50k is a nice round boundary; looks like a RoPE rollover at the 2^15-ish mark but index is not exactly 32768 etc. Two hypotheses: 1) position->phase mapping uses a different base freq for this model which puts a wrap at ~50000; 2) int3 interpolation kernel under-approximates exponent which creates a discrete jump at rollover.

dina: try toggling rotary-scaling and also run int4-hybrid and int8 to see trend.

samir: ran quick matrix:
- pelican-80k-fp16 : clean to 81k
- pelican-80k-int8  : small drift near 50k but no corruption
- pelican-80k-int4  : mild artifacts but recover
- pelican-80k-int3  : deterministic corruption at 50k (worst)

eval-bot: mini-holdout (repeat prompt):
- pelican-80k-fp16 : ppl(0-50k)=7.6, ppl(50k-81k)=7.7
- pelican-80k-int8 : ppl(0-50k)=7.8, ppl(50k-81k)=8.1
- pelican-80k-int3 : ppl(0-50k)=8.1, ppl(50k-81k)=12.0  <-- severe tail regression (+48% rel)

oliver: next steps I recommend: 1) add a low-index synthetic that wraps at e.g. 512 so we can bisect quickly; 2) instrument rotary exponent outputs from kernel for positions 49990..50010 comparing fp32 vs int3; 3) add kv-fingerprint check into regression suite for any new int3 profiles.

mira: I'll add a unit `tests/regressions/rotary_rollover_mini.py` that runs in CI and fails on fp discontinuity; also add a telemetry gauge for sudden kv fingerprint deltas > 1.

samir: filed INF-4702 with repro command, kvpeek, eval-bot summary, and assigned to eng-ml/rotary-quant. Created PR 1399 to add the mini test + kv assert (wip).

dina: nice. also add note in model-onboarding checklist: "run rollover_mini and longctx-smoke for all int3/int4 profiles". tagging @mira and @oliver for review. :rocket:
